semanticReview.conclusion: Contract version is literal 1; batch and each event family reject unknown keys. Batch count is 1–500; source identifiers have bounded lengths and reject blank input; correction reason is bounded and nonblank. No free-form payload or executable expression field is introduced.

Batch event identities are keyed by serialized [producer,eventId]. Source-record revisions are separately keyed by [producer,sourceRecordId,revision]. Equal local event IDs from different producers do not collide. Persistent cross-batch uniqueness is explicitly outstanding.

Initial revisions cannot supersede; later revisions require a distinct event at an earlier revision and nonblank reason. A correction target present in the batch must match producer/source record/event family/declared prior revision. Originals are preserved in the input batch. Missing cross-batch targets, chain freshness and authenticated source ownership remain adapter checks.

Person/account/opportunity/purchase IDs remain separate, producer-scoped source references. Recorded touchpoint identity requires at least one explicit ID; unresolved identity cannot carry claimed recorded links. The validator performs no CRM lookup, fuzzy merge, customer deduplication or count/value aggregation.

Money accepts nonnegative bounded decimal strings through the existing 14-integer/4-fractional-digit storage constraint and rejects JSON numeric monetary amounts. Currency and currency-major unit are explicit. It performs no FX conversion or equivalence between order/purchase/invoice/payment/cost/profit. Commerce quantity is a safe nonnegative integer; delivery quantity is finite/nonnegative with hours/units declared. Actual signed-source conventions, allocation, recognition and source mapping still require qualified adapters.

Offset instants are checked by Temporal rather than JavaScript Date, retaining submillisecond ordering up to nanoseconds. Instant/civil-day windows are distinct and require a later exclusive end. Storage declares Gregorian ISO dates while calendar provenance can be Gregorian/Persian; an adapter must still verify actual calendar/timezone period boundaries. Declared timezone uses the existing shared validator and does not select a SQL report scope here.

Assignment method explicitly distinguishes randomized/observational/unknown; exposure references an assignment event and unit without claiming authenticated linkage. Geo unit counts are bounded safe nonnegative integers; exposed/converted units cannot exceed eligible units. Control conversions are correctly permitted without exposure. Assignment/exposure linkage, eligibility, randomization, unit deduplication, contamination, causal analysis and uncertainty are not implemented by these schemas.

No database client, HTTP transport, provider SDK, file/object store, ingestion route, credential, queue, marketing send, campaign mutation or persistent cache is used. The schema advertises unqualified payload validation only. No existing Goals/KPI authoring source is touched.

resolvedFindings.originalIssue: The first draft keyed event lookup by eventId alone, falsely colliding independent producer namespaces and misresolving same-batch supersedes.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final source uses sourceEventKey(producer,eventId) for both duplicate detection and correction lookup; source namespace meaning is explicit.

resolvedFindings.originalIssue: min(1) alone admitted whitespace-only correction reasons.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final source also requires a non-whitespace character while preserving original supplied text.
